acceptance: The code path that prints the warning is identified and the reason it fired for a pull request that did not touch the named files is recorded.
The warning fires only when the two pull requests change an overlapping file, or its text says plainly that the other pull request conflicts with `develop`, proven by a unit test.
description: `make pr-open` for PR #4170 printed: `textual conflict with PR #3916 (chore/seed-corpus-20261101-3095) in publication/ledger-seed.json, results-data/corpus-inventory.json — coordinate before landing`. PR #4170 changed nine files, none of them those two, and merged without conflict. The cause was not investigated: the warning may compare the other pull request against `develop` rather than against this branch, in which case it is noise on every `pr-open` while #3916 is open.
